module: Hardware telemetry utility module (loaded by require): compares two controller snapshots to produce connection/disconnection events, and says which display transitions (window/fullscreen) are tracked. Relies on telemetry/hardwareInput.

controllerSnapshot.desc: Builds a snapshot keyed by device name, limited to the gamepad, joystick, wheel and xinput types (keyboard, mouse, openxr, vinput ignored). Each entry contains device, deviceType, productName, vidpid and forceFeedback; for a wheel, the official English name is looked up via hardwareInput.officialEnglishName.

controllerInfo.desc: List of controllers (name, type, productName, vidpid, ffbAxes...).

connectionChanges.desc: Compares two snapshots and returns the list of events {...device fields, connected = true|false}. Connections come first, sorted by name, then disconnections. If the same name changes vidpid or productName, it produces a connection (new device) and a disconnection (old one).

isTrackedDisplayTransition.desc: True only for the direct transitions 'Window' to 'Fullscreen' and 'Fullscreen' to 'Window'.

returns.desc: true if the transition is tracked.
